issues.display_title: Issue #4323: Implement Real-time PayPal Subscription Status Polling in Checkout Modal
issues.main_description_html:
Objective

Replace the client-side browser capture (POST /paypal/subscriptions/capture) with real-time status polling (GET /paypal/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/status) for PayPal recurring subscriptions, pairing with backend webhook ingestion to prevent lost payments when users close the modal prematurely.

Implementation Requirements

1. Status Polling Hook

  • Create src/components/organism/PaymentV2/Hooks/usePaypalSubscriptionStatus.jsx:
    • Poll GET /paypal/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/status using useLazyFetch with user accessToken.
    • Configurable interval: 2000ms, max attempts: 15 (30 seconds).
    • Callbacks: onActive, onFailed, and onTimeout.
    • Expose cancellation function for cleanup when modal closes or unmounts.

2. Integration in PaymentV2

  • File: src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.jsx:
    • In handlePaypalSubscriptionApprove(data):
      • For non-test users and one-time orders: retain existing capturePaypalSubscription flow during rollout.
      • For test users on recurring subscriptions: initiate status polling via pollSubscriptionStatus.
      • On status "active": trigger handleSubscribeSuccess(), track analytics, refresh user profile, and close modal.
      • On status "failed": trigger handleSubscribeError() with the PayPal rejection message and stop loading.
      • On timeout (30s): assume background processing, close loader gracefully.

3. Unit Tests & Analytics

  • File: src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.countly.test.jsx:
    • Ensure Countly funnel events (checkout_started, payment_completed, payment_failed) continue to record accurately with sanitized context for both poll-based and capture-based flows.

Linked Pull Request

  • PR: #4322
  • Backend API PR: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1935

issues.display_title: Issue #4328: Fix PayPal subscription timeout handling: remove fake success & show localized processing alert
issues.main_description_html:
Context & Problem

When PayPal SSE stream times out or drops, PaymentV2.jsx previously called onPaymentFinalSuccess(), causing fake/optimistic success before webhook completion.

Requirements

  1. Remove optimistic success on timeout.
  2. Display localized alert informing user that PayPal is processing payment.
  3. Cleanly dismiss payment modal and reset loading state.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Stream timeout does not trigger fake purchase success or unlock features.
  • Localized alert displayed via existing i18n system.
  • Payment modal closes gracefully with loading dismissed.

Result Summary

  • Implementation:
    • Added localized key t_payment_v2.t_paypal_timeout_processing across all 18 locale files.
    • In PaymentV2.jsx (onTimeout), replaced fake success with localized toast notification, loading reset, and clean modal dismissal (onDismiss).
    • Added clean EventSource connection teardown in usePaypalSubscriptionStatus.jsx.
  • Testing:
    • Telemetry unit tests passed in PaymentV2.countly.test.jsx.
    • Verified via automated E2E test: modal closes gracefully on 60s timeout, displays processing alert, and avoids fake success screen.
  • PR: #4329
